segments.mil7.5.9:1.1: “Bhante nāgasena,‘varāhassa dve aṅgāni gahetabbānī’ti yaṃ vadesi, katamāni tāni dve aṅgāni gahetabbānī”ti?
segments.mil7.5.9:1.2: “Yathā, mahārāja, varāho santattakaṭhite [santattakaṭhine (sī. pī.)] gimhasamaye sampatte udakaṃ upagacchati, evameva kho, mahārāja, yoginā yogāvacarena dosena citte āluḷitakhalitavibbhantasantatte sītalāmatapaṇītamettābhāvanaṃ upagantabbaṃ.
segments.mil7.5.9:1.4: Idaṃ, mahārāja, varāhassa paṭhamaṃ aṅgaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
segments.mil7.5.9:2.1: “Puna caparaṃ, mahārāja, varāho cikkhallamudakamupagantvā nāsikāya pathaviṃ khaṇitvā doṇiṃ katvā doṇikāya sayati, evameva kho, mahārāja, yoginā yogāvacarena mānase kāyaṃ nikkhipitvā ārammaṇantaragatena sayitabbaṃ.
segments.mil7.5.9:2.3: Idaṃ, mahārāja, varāhassa dutiyaṃ aṅgaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
